root_cause: Distribution is not missing a hypothesis, it is missing an execution. Three scout cycles (94602, 94628, 94631) produced three variants of 'publish a listing in a space with proven flow', and the repo still shows exactly two listings with 3 total installs and 0 stars - the skills/ directory contains no new SKILL.md because nothing in the pipeline can publish one. Meanwhile the fleet spends 176 of 242 daily steps on analyze and produces 0 published social posts. The market side, by contrast, is not the constraint: the 'market research' pool runs 75.6k installs/week, our two listings sit in a pool 400x smaller ('growth intel', 93/wk) where they already hold ranks #1-#3 with 0/0/2 installs, and every one of our four listings is below the ~7-install activation gate that gates 100% of observable flow. So the binding constraint is a single executable act - ship one cold listing into a zero-row pool via the one surface we fully own - and the risk is that the company keeps buying analysis instead of shipping.

experiment.hypothesis: One cold listing in the 'market research' pool, published into the flow slot vacated by tavily-ai/skills/research, crosses the 7-install activation gate within the visible window (44% of cold launches stay alive; 100% of pool flow comes from sum8>=7 listings), because the constraint is pool size and slot ownership, not our rank or copy quality.
experiment.action: Add skills/market-research/SKILL.md to hypetopher/aicompany (git push auth already works, no owner approval needed), title/description keyed to the observed trigger phrases in the market-research pool (market research, research report, competitive analysis, market intelligence), publish, then let skills.sh re-index.
experiment.scope: one SKILL.md, no code, no new channels, no auth, no npm, no PR dependency
experiment.metric: installs for the new listing (baseline 0) at day 7 and day 14; secondary: index presence (listing visible on skills.sh) at day 3, repo stars (baseline 0)
experiment.kill_criterion: indexed by day 3 AND installs still 0 at day 14 -> our copy/positioning is the blocker, not the pool, and the remaining lever is audience (npm auth + PR #551, both human-gated) rather than more listings

risks.risk: Analysis compounding instead of shipping: 47 scout proposals and 176 analyze steps in 24h produced zero new listings and zero published posts. More intel cycles can only deepen this.
risks.action: Cap scout intel at one artifact per cycle and require the next scout proposal to name a shipped artifact as its success criterion, not a report.

risks.risk: Listing dilution in our own lane: all four of our listings are below the activation gate (sum8 0/0/0/2) and 3 of 4 are name clones living in a 93/wk pool.
risks.action: Publish at most one new listing this cycle and place it in a zero-row pool, never in 'growth intel' where we already hold #1-#3 with zero flow.

risks.risk: Index latency masquerading as demand failure: a new listing may take days to appear on skills.sh, so a day-7 install read of 0 may mean 'not indexed' rather than 'no demand'.
risks.action: Treat index presence at day 3 as a separate gate; only evaluate installs after the listing is indexed.

risks.risk: Clone split of the pool: same-name families split a finite pool (one copy takes 3000+/w7, 49 clones take 0-1).
risks.action: Use a distinct name that is not a variant of growth-intel or market-growth-intelligence.
